title: Live Deliciously
summary: Every hero took the goat's offer, and every wish came true, bent.
when: not flag.kehlenn_bound and flag.horned_bargains >= party_size and party_size > 0

epilogue.title: The Wishes
epilogue.text: The wishes came true, each a little bent. The heroes are fed, and honoured, and quite unable to stop smiling.
